metadata.question: Were the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels higher over Shanghai than over Wuhan during April 20-May 12, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 product (COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2) - Date range: April 20 - May 12, 2020 - Two locations: Shanghai and Wuhan (Point geometries or small buffers) - Band: 'tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density' 2. Masking strategy: - Use quality assurance band (qa_value) to filter out low-quality pixels - Typical threshold: qa_value >= 0.75 for good quality data - This is about NO2 levels, not clouds, so we should mask poor quality data 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid Zero (A/B): If both cities have valid measurements (count > 0) and we can compare them - C1: If no images found in the date range - C2: If images exist but all pixels masked out (count = 0) - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN or invalid NO2 values (e.g., negative when shouldn't be) - Compare mean values: if Shanghai > Wuhan, answer A; else B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const shanghai = ee.Geometry.Point([121.4737, 31.2304]); const wuhan = ee.Geometry.Point([114.3055, 30.5928]); const startDate = '2020-04-20'; const endDate = '2020-05-12'; // Buffer for regional average (10km radius) const shanghaiRegion = shanghai.buffer(10000); const wuhanRegion = wuhan.buffer(10000); // 2. Data Acquisition const no2Collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density') .filterDate(startDate, endDate); const shanghaiCol = no2Collection.filterBounds(shanghaiRegion); const wuhanCol = no2Collection.filterBounds(wuhanRegion); const shanghaiSize = shanghaiCol.size().getInfo(); const wuhanSize = wuhanCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Shanghai images: ${shanghaiSize}`); console.log(`Wuhan images: ${wuhanSize}`); if (shanghaiSize === 0 || wuhanSize === 0) { console.log("No data for one or both cities."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Quality masking and processing function maskPoorQuality(image) { const qa = image.select('qa_value'); const mask = qa.gte(0.75); return image.updateMask(mask); } const shanghaiFiltered = shanghaiCol.map(maskPoorQuality); const wuhanFiltered = wuhanCol.map(maskPoorQuality); // Create mean composites const shanghaiMean = shanghaiFiltered.mean(); const wuhanMean = wuhanFiltered.mean(); // 4. Calculate statistics with pixel counts const shanghaiStats = shanghaiMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: shanghaiRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const wuhanStats = wuhanMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: wuhanRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const shanghaiValue = shanghaiStats['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean']; const shanghaiCount = shanghaiStats['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count']; const wuhanValue = wuhanStats['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean']; const wuhanCount = wuhanStats['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count']; console.log(`Shanghai: Mean=${shanghaiValue}, Pixels=${shanghaiCount}`); console.log(`Wuhan: Mean=${wuhanValue}, Pixels=${wuhanCount}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (shanghaiCount === 0 || wuhanCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after quality masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (shanghaiValue === null || shanghaiValue === undefined || wuhanValue === null || wuhanValue === undefined || isNaN(shanghaiValue) || isNaN(wuhanValue)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid values."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Convert from mol/m^2 to more readable units (x 1e6 for micromol/m^2) const shanghaiMicromol = shanghaiValue * 1e6; const wuhanMicromol = wuhanValue * 1e6; console.log(`Shanghai NO2: ${shanghaiMicromol.toFixed(2)} micromol/m^2`); console.log(`Wuhan NO2: ${wuhanMicromol.toFixed(2)} micromol/m^2`); if (shanghaiValue > wuhanValue) { console.log("Shanghai had higher tropospheric NO2 levels than Wuhan."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Shanghai did not have higher tropospheric NO2 levels than Wuhan."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
